data.summary: Dachdeckerei Beispielziegel GmbH issued a final invoice (Schlussrechnung) for renewing the roof gutter, a new downpipe with leaf guard, and scaffolding, totaling €1,249.50, due within 30 days of the invoice date (20 November 2026).
data.explanation: This is a final invoice (Schlussrechnung) for roofing/gutter work that has been completed. You need to pay the total amount of €1,249.50 by bank transfer to the IBAN given, quoting the invoice number as the payment reference, by the deadline shown (the app calculates it from the invoice date). If you don't pay in time, the company may send reminders or charge late fees. Keep this invoice for your tax return: craftsman labor costs (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be partially deducted, but only the labor portion paid by bank transfer, not materials or cash payments.
data.tax_note: Craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen) like this roof gutter repair can be partly deductible under §35a EStG (20% of labor cost, up to a cap), provided payment is made by bank transfer rather than cash; keep this invoice and the payment proof.

items.title: Pay the roof gutter invoice
items.action: Transfer €1,249.50 to the company's IBAN, quoting the invoice number DZ-26-0419 as the payment reference.
